provenance.captured_by: GET https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?resultsPerPage=200&startIndex={0,200,400}[&pubStartDate=<from>T00:00:00.000&pubEndDate=<to>T00:00:00.000], over pubStart/pubEnd windows in 2019, 2021, 2024, 2025 and 2026 plus the unfiltered head of the index; every distinct (cvssData.vectorString, cvssData.baseScore) pair from metrics.cvssMetricV31 and metrics.cvssMetricV30, first CVE kept.
provenance.what_this_is: The oracle for src/dependency_risk_profiler/vulnerabilities/cvss.py. NVD publishes the vector string and the base score it computed from it, side by side, for every CVE it scores -- so each row is a CVSS v3.x base score with a publisher behind it, not an expectation this repository wrote down. AGENTS.md rule 5: captured, never authored. A hand-written table here would encode whatever the implementation already does, which is exactly the failure #273 is.
trimming: Duplicate vectors collapsed to their first occurrence. Volume only: NVD publishes one score per vector, so a repeated vector adds no distinct assertion. No metric combination present in the pull was dropped.
